title: Heavier Core
body:
### What is Heavier Core?
Heavier Core is a very simple data pack that makes one change: heavy cores fall now.
Just like other blocks like sand, gravel, and anvils, the heavy core will now fall when not supported by a block.

### What does that mean?
Like an anvil, a falling heavy core will damage entities below, but unlike an anvil, the heavy core will launch itself back up with a wind burst.

### Warning: could not locate heavy core!

![Warning: Failed to find heavy core! Try breaking and replacing it. (image)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b35a3284aa3dc1bf06e3adab6294fa48a0c7dca.png)

this warning appears when the datapack fails to find the heavy core that you placed. It means that the core will not behave like a falling block. Unfortunately, this is unavoidable due to the limitations of data packs.

### Why not just make a mod?
<details>
<summary>There are multiple reasons behind this decision</summary>

1. I'm not confident in my mod development skills yet. I know how to develop datapacks much better.
2. Multi version support. making and maintaining a datapack available for multiple versions is much easier than doing the same with a mod.
3. No dependencies: No other mods or mod loaders are required for this project to work. Since its a datapack, the client doesnt even need to install it!

</details>
